common.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
common.notAllowed: You don't have permission to open this page.

gate.webOnly: The admin panel opens only on the web.
gate.signIn: Sign in to open the admin panel.
gate.notStaff: This area is only for AYWO staff.

permissionHelp.dictionary: approve new words, decide wrong-word reports
permissionHelp.users: find accounts, block and unblock them
permissionHelp.trees: find trees; see a tree's people with a reason
permissionHelp.payments: see plans and orders, refund orders, give free Plus days
permissionHelp.support: answer help tickets, look up accounts
permissionHelp.moderation: decide abuse reports about memories, comments, chats and accounts
permissionHelp.orders: print and ship posters and books, see shipping addresses with a reason
permissionHelp.marketing: coupons, scrolling banners and promotional messages
permissionHelp.analytics: growth and use charts, crash reports
permissionHelp.settings: forced update, maintenance, feature switches, crash reports

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Counts only. Family details stay private.
dashboard.empty: No permissions have been given to you yet. Ask an AYWO Admin.
dashboard.twoStepTitle: Turn on your second sign-in step
dashboard.twoStepText: It takes a minute and protects family data if your phone number is ever taken over. It becomes required when AYWO goes live.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Phone numbers and emails are partly hidden.
users.search: Name, id, email or full phone number
users.name: Name
users.blockText: This signs the account out everywhere and stops new sign-ins.
users.unblockText: This account will be able to sign in again.

trees.title: Trees
trees.subtitle: Names and counts only. Seeing a tree's people needs a reason, and every look is recorded.
trees.search: Tree name, tree id or Creator's id
trees.name: Tree
trees.creator: Creator
trees.askText: You will see names only, never contact details. Your name and reason go in the audit log.
trees.lookRecorded: Recorded in the audit log. Reason: {{reason}}

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: New relationship words and reports of wrong words.
dictionary.approveText: It joins the dictionary for everyone.
dictionary.rejectText: It stays out of the dictionary.
dictionary.acceptText: With a corrected word below, the word is replaced and marked verified. With the box empty, the word is withdrawn.
dictionary.correctedNative: Corrected word, in its own script
dictionary.dismissText: The word stays as it is.

takedowns.title: Takedown requests
takedowns.subtitle: People asking to be removed from a tree someone else made.
takedowns.noPersonLinked: Not linked to a tree yet
takedowns.askedBy: How to reach the person asking
takedowns.note: Your note (recorded in the audit log)
takedowns.personId: Person id (find it on the Trees page)
takedowns.removeText: This person disappears from the tree, their contact details are deleted, and the tree's Creator is told. It can't be brought back from history.
takedowns.dismissText: Nothing changes in the tree. Reply to the person asking yourself.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Plans and payments. Order refunds are on the Orders page; plan refunds happen at the store or gateway.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: AYWO's own team. This has nothing to do with a tree's Creator.
staff.name: Name
staff.addText: If this number has never signed in, it gets an invite that works at its first sign-in, for 14 days.
staff.removeText: The account stays. Its staff access ends at once.
staff.adminHelp: An AYWO Admin can do everything, including managing staff and reading the audit log.
staff.teamRolesHelp: A team role is a named set of permissions. Changing a role changes everyone in it.
staff.resetText: They are signed out and must set up their authenticator app again at the next sign-in.
staff.invitedText: This number hasn't signed in to AYWO yet. It becomes staff at its first sign-in within 14 days.
staff.roleChangesAll_one: {{count}} person has this role. Changes apply to them at once.
staff.roleChangesAll_other: {{count}} people have this role. Changes apply to them at once.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every staff action. Nobody can change or delete this record.
audit.search: Filter by action, for example takedown

actions.takedown_removed: Removed a person after a takedown
actions.ticket_answered_closed: Answered and closed a help ticket

broadcast.title: System notices
broadcast.subtitle: For things every member must know, such as planned downtime or a change in terms. Never for marketing.
broadcast.heading: Heading
broadcast.confirmText: It goes to every account by push and email, and it can't be taken back. The reason you write is kept in the audit log.

twoStep.codeText: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for AYWO staff. You'll be asked again in 12 hours.
twoStep.lost: Lost your phone? Ask an AYWO Admin to reset your second step.
twoStep.setupText: Staff accounts can see private data, so they need a second step: a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoStep.step1: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account with this setup key:
twoStep.step2: 2. Type the 6-digit code the app shows:

work.title: Work queue
work.subtitle: Everything waiting for staff, in one place. Give each item an owner, keep it moving, and finish before the deadline.
work.goTo: Go to the page to decide
work.noteHelp: Staff only. The person never sees this.

reports.title: Abuse reports
reports.subtitle: What people reported about memories, comments, chat messages and accounts. Decide each within 24 hours.
reports.removeText: It disappears for everyone. Every open report about it closes, and the people who reported it are told action was taken.
reports.removeProfileText: The account is blocked: signed out everywhere and unable to sign in.
reports.dismissText: Nothing changes. The person who reported it is told it was looked at.

tickets.title: Help tickets
tickets.subtitle: Questions from the app's help centre. Your answers show as "AYWO Support", never your own name.
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.replyHelp: The person gets a notification and reads it in the app.
tickets.isClosed: This ticket is closed. A reply from the person opens it again.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Posters and books from paid to delivered. The buyer is told at each step.
orders.search: Order id, tracking number or buyer id
orders.cancelText: The buyer is told. Refund the payment too if it was paid.
orders.refundText: The money goes back through Razorpay or Stripe to the way the buyer paid. This can't be undone.
orders.addressText: Write why you need the address. It's recorded in the audit log.
orders.noAddress: This order has no shipping address.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Coupons, scrolling banners and promotional messages.
offers.couponsHelp: Coupons work for posters, books and premium invites. Discounts on AYWO Plus inside the iPhone and Android apps must be Apple or Google offer codes, made in their own consoles.
offers.usedNote: This code has been used, so its code and discount stay fixed. You can still change the dates and limits, or switch it off.
offers.codeHelp: 4 to 20 letters and numbers, for example DIWALI20.
offers.newOnly: Only for a person's first order
offers.showInApp: Show on the Offers screen in the app

placementsHelp.app_banner: Scrolling strip at the top of the app
placementsHelp.web_banner: Scrolling strip on the public website

offers.bannersHelp: Short news or offers that scroll across the top of the app or the website. Keep the title under 60 letters.
offers.bannerTitleHelp: This scrolls. Example: Diwali offer: 20% off family posters
offers.linkHelp: An app page like /offers, or a full https link.
offers.linkLabel: Button word, for example See offer
offers.linkBad: The link must start with / or https://
offers.messagesHelp: A push notification to people who switched on offers and news in the app. At most two a day. Safety and service news go through System notices instead.
offers.willReach_one: Goes to {{count}} person. {{optedIn}} people have switched on offers.
offers.willReach_other: Goes to {{count}} people. {{optedIn}} people have switched on offers.
offers.sendText: It can't be taken back. Your reason goes in the audit log.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Counts only. No one's family details appear here.

settings.title: App settings
settings.subtitle: Changes reach every app within a minute, without a new release.

confirm.min_version: Phones on an older version must update before they can use AYWO.
confirm.latest_version: Phones on an older version see a gentle reminder to update.
confirm.maintenance: While maintenance is on, everyone except staff sees the message instead of the app.
confirm.features: Switched-off features disappear from the apps at once.
confirm.whats_new: People see this once after updating to this version.
confirm.support: Shown on the Contact and Help pages.

settings.versionsHelp: Below the minimum, the app stops and asks for an update. Below the latest, it suggests one.
settings.maintenanceHelp: For planned work. SOS alarms that are already running keep working.
settings.maintenanceSwitch: Show the maintenance message instead of the app
settings.maintenanceMessage: Message, for example Back at 6 pm
settings.featuresHelp: Turn a feature off quickly if it misbehaves.
settings.whatsNewHelp: Shown once to people after they update. One line per item, up to six.
settings.healthHelp: Crashes the apps reported. Numbers, emails and ids are removed before saving. Kept 30 days.

user360.title: Account
user360.subtitle: Everything staff may see about one account. Family details stay private.
user360.askTitle: Why are you opening this account?
user360.askText: Your name and reason go in the audit log, and the account's history shows it.
user360.creator: Creator

confirmText.block: Signed out everywhere, and new sign-ins stop.
confirmText.unblock: The account can sign in again.
confirmText.end: Every phone and browser is signed out. The account stays open.
confirmText.plus: Added on top of any free days they already have. They get a notification.

funnel.title: Step by step: devices that first opened the app in the last {{count}} days
funnel.help: Anonymous: a random id per device, no names or numbers. Each step counts once per device.
funnel.empty: No devices opened the app in this period yet.
funnel.biggestDrop: Most people stop before "{{step}}": {{count}} lost there.
funnel.splitLine: {{opened}} opened, {{verified}}% verified, {{tree}}% started a tree, {{five}}% reached 5 people

ops.noBackup: No good backup yet. Check that BACKUP_KEY is set (docs/runbook-backups.md).
ops.jobsFailing: Failing 3 times or more in a row: {{names}}

errors.admin_not_allowed: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.admin_staff_only: Only an AYWO Admin can do this to staff.
errors.admin_cannot_block_self: You can't block your own account.
errors.admin_cannot_change_self: You can't change your own staff place. Ask another AYWO Admin.
errors.admin_reason_required: Please write a reason of at least 5 characters.
errors.admin_user_not_found: No account found. The person must sign in to AYWO once first.
errors.admin_not_found: That item wasn't found. It may be gone.
errors.admin_already_staff: This person is already on the staff.
errors.admin_permission_required: Choose at least one permission for a Sub-admin.
errors.admin_takedown_needs_person: Give the id of the person to remove. Find it on the Trees page.
errors.admin_audit_append_only: The audit log can't be changed.
errors.person_taken_down: This person was removed after a takedown request and can't be brought back.
errors.takedown_too_many: We've already received several requests from you. We'll reply soon.
errors.phone_invalid: That phone number doesn't look right. Include the country code.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.admin_broadcast_bad_text: A notice needs a heading of 3 to 80 letters and a message of 10 to 500.
errors.admin_broadcast_too_many: Three notices have gone out in the last day. Please wait before sending another.
errors.admin_two_step_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.admin_two_step_setup: Set up your second sign-in step first.
errors.admin_two_step_wrong: That code isn't right. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
errors.admin_two_step_already: Your second step is already set up.
errors.admin_role_name_taken: There's already a team role with that name.
errors.admin_role_in_use: People still have this role. Move them to another role first.
errors.admin_assignee_not_allowed: That person can't open this kind of work. Give them the permission first.
errors.admin_campaign_too_many: Two promotional messages have gone out today. Please wait until tomorrow.
errors.coupon_code_taken: That code is already used by another coupon.
errors.coupon_in_use: This code has been used, so its code and discount can't change.
errors.order_not_shippable: This order can't be shipped. It may be unpaid, refunded or digital.
errors.order_bad_step: That step doesn't follow from where the order is now.
errors.order_tracking_required: Add a tracking number to mark it shipped.
errors.order_not_refundable: This order can't be refunded here. It may be unpaid or already refunded.
errors.payment_provider_error: The payment provider didn't answer. Please try again in a minute.
errors.use_store_billing: This was bought through Apple or Google. Refund it in their console.
